next_step: POC kickoff with Dedicated nodes + JetBrains plugin prototype
notes:
- Product: JetBrains IDE plugin (IntelliJ/PyCharm) + optional local indexer daemon for very large monorepos.
- Primary ask: sub-50ms completion latency for local completions (cold-start target 100ms), streaming tokens to IDE with incremental updates.
- Privacy: MUST allow local-only indexing; no source code leaves customer network for core completions. They will accept embeddings to be computed on-prem or in VPC.
- Model/version pinning important: reproducible completions for CI checks, audits. Wants ability to pin per-team model + quantized variant.
- Deployment: prefer Dedicated for POC (predictable throughput), eventual Private (VPC or on-prem) for paid customers.
- SDK: asks for example plugin integration (Java/Kotlin) and a small gRPC/REST shim to the Redwood runtime to fetch streaming tokens.
- Pain points: JetBrains plugin ecosystem requires small memory footprint; local indexer must expose symbol server API compatible with IDE indexing hooks.
- Quote from CTO (call 11/05): "We will not accept cloud crawlers or code upload; offline-first is non-negotiable."
- Pricing sensitivity: mid-market budget but expects clear cost controls (per-user vs per-token hybrid).
- Risk: competitor (GitHub Copilot) already included in dev toolchain; our differentiator must be privacy + low-latency + pinning.
- Internal notes: AE demo went well; SE call scheduled 11/12 (deep-dive on plugin hooks). Security sent SSO and KMS questionnaire 11/18. Legal on NDA exchange 12/02.
- Typical response style in notes: bullets, short action items, follow-ups.
